context-lost: The browser reset this page’s graphics. It should come back on its own — reload if it does not.
error-connect: Could not reach the game server.
error-kicked: The host removed you from the lobby.
error-lobby-capacity: The server is full. Try again shortly.
error-need-more-players: A race needs at least two players.
game-description: 진짜 천, 진짜 중력. 공중에서 옷을 잡아 세탁 방법에 맞는 통에 넣으세요 — 색상과 직물 모두.
no-open-lobbies: Nobody is waiting right now. Create one and share the code.
no-scores-yet: 아직 점수가 없습니다. 첫 번째로 도전하세요!
rematch-hint: Rematch keeps the room open — code {{code}}.
rotate-hint: Turn your phone sideways for a bigger playfield.
rule-controls: Drag with mouse, finger or pen. Or steer with the arrow keys and pinch with Space.
rule-correct: Right bin: +{{points}}, and every streak sort adds 10% up to +100%.
rule-missed: Dropped on the floor: no penalty, but the streak still breaks.
rule-wrong: Wrong bin: {{points}} and the streak breaks.
score-not-saved: Couldn't save that score — the run still counted locally.
sign-in-to-play: 로그인하여 플레이하고, 점수를 저장하고, 다른 사람들과 경주하세요.
waiting-for-others: Your round is done — waiting for the rest of the room.
waiting-for-players: Share the code — a race needs at least two people.
waiting-for-ready: Waiting for everyone to ready up.
